section_summary.extract_value: This section reports reliability analyses for the BAS-2 instrument. The composite reliability (Cronbach's alpha) was .93 for both boys and girls. Temporal stability testing (n = 46) demonstrated strong test-retest reliability with ICC values of .98 (95% CI = .97, .99) between two applications of the BAS-2.
